# Sharing and/or reusing code

1. I am aware that there is a large amount of code available on the *web* to solve many problems.

2. You may use online resources (e.g. StackOverflow) but you must cite them properly, even if you only use them as inspiration.

3. If code is found to be recycled and is not explicitly cited, it will be treated as plagiarism.

4. Sharing code is forbidden in all graded work (homework, quizzes and the final exam).

<br>

<center>
<a href="https://stackoverflow.com/">
<img src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/02/Stack_Overflow_logo.svg", style="width:75%">
</a>
</center>

# Grading

* **Homework:** Maximum 2 members per group. Ideally the same group throughout the semester.

* **Quizzes:** They will be held **in person** on Thursdays during the teaching assistant session. Individual work.

* **Final Exam:** Individual work and covers everything seen in the course. It will be held in person on the last day of class.

| Component     | Weight      |
|---------------|:-----------:|
| Homework (4)  |  40%        |
| Quizzes (4)   |  35%        |
| Final Exam    |  25%        |

* [<i class="fas fa-download"></i>](files/homework-policies.pdf) Submission policy (Docencia Web/Canvas).

* Minimum 60% in-person attendance in the classroom.

# Python Vs C++ Vs Java

* Python
    ```{python, echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
    print('Python Vs C++ Vs Java!')
    ```
    
* C++
    ```{cc, echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
    # include <iostream>
    
    void main()
    {
      cout << "Python Vs C++!"
    }
    ```

* Java
    ```{java, echo=TRUE, eval=FALSE}
    public class PythonVsJava 
    {
      public static void main(String[] args)
      {
        System.out.println("Python Vs Java!");  
      }
    }
    ```

## Most used languages

```{r, echo = FALSE, eval = TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
p_load("tidyverse", "highcharter", "shiny")

kaggle_survey <- read_csv(here::here("dataset/kaggle_survey_2020_responses.csv"))

lang_use <- kaggle_survey %>% 
  slice(-1) %>% 
  select(Q7_Part_1:Q7_Part_12) %>% 
  summarise(across(Q7_Part_1:Q7_Part_12, ~ length(na.omit(.x)))) %>%
  set_names(c('Python', 'R', 'SQL', 'C', 'C++', 'Java', 'Javascript', 'Julia', 'Swift', 'Bash', 'Matlab', 'None')) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  `colnames<-`('n_per_lang') %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "lang") %>% 
  mutate(pct = (n_per_lang / sum(n_per_lang)) * 100) %>% 
  filter(lang != 'None')

hc1 <- lang_use %>% 
  mutate(pct = round(pct, 2)) %>% 
  hchart("column", hcaes(x = lang, y = pct), name = "Language", color = "rgb(247,163,92)") %>%
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = ""), labels = list(format = "{value}%")) %>%
  hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "")) %>%
  hc_credits(enabled = TRUE, text = "2020 Kaggle Machine Learning & Data Science Survey") %>%
  hc_tooltip(sort = TRUE, table = FALSE, pointFormat = '<span style="color:{series.color};"/>{series.name} </span>:{point.y}{point.percentage:.1f}%')
  
hc1
```

---
## Which languages would you recommend?

```{r, echo = FALSE, eval = TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, out.width="100%"}
lang_recom <- kaggle_survey %>% 
  slice(-1) %>% 
  select(Q8) %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(total = n()) %>% 
  group_by(Q8) %>% 
  mutate(n_per_lang = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(pct = (n_per_lang / total) * 100) %>% 
  distinct(Q8, pct) %>% 
  set_names(c('lang', 'pct')) %>% 
  filter(lang != 'None')

hc2 <- lang_recom %>% 
  mutate(pct = round(pct, 2)) %>% 
  hchart("column", hcaes(x = lang, y = pct), name = "Language", color = "rgb(247,163,92)") %>%
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = ""), labels = list(format = "{value}%")) %>%
  hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "")) %>%
  hc_credits(enabled = TRUE, text = "2020 Kaggle Machine Learning & Data Science Survey") %>%
  hc_tooltip(sort = TRUE, table = FALSE, pointFormat = '<span style="color:{series.color};"/>{series.name} </span>:{point.y}{point.percentage:.1f}%')
  
hc2
```

---
## Which languages do you use regularly?

```{r, eval=TRUE, out.width="100%"}
lang_use_per_role <- kaggle_survey %>% 
  slice(-1) %>% 
  select(Q5, Q7_Part_1:Q7_Part_12) %>% 
  drop_na(Q5) %>% 
  group_by(Q5) %>% 
  summarise(across(Q7_Part_1:Q7_Part_12, ~ (length(na.omit(.x)) / length(.x))) * 100) %>% 
  set_names(c('role', 'Python', 'R', 'SQL', 'C', 'C++', 'Java', 'Javascript', 'Julia', 'Swift', 'Bash', 'Matlab', 'None')) %>%
  gather("lang", "pct", -role) %>% 
  group_by(role) %>% 
  filter(lang != 'None')

hc3 <- lang_use_per_role %>% 
  mutate(pct = round(pct, 2)) %>% 
  hchart("column", hcaes(x = role, y = pct, group = lang)) %>%
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = ""), labels = list(format = "{value}%")) %>%
  hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "")) %>%
  hc_credits(enabled = TRUE, text = "2020 Kaggle Machine Learning & Data Science Survey") %>%
  hc_tooltip(sort = TRUE, table = TRUE)
  
hc3
```

---
## Which IDE do you use regularly?

```{r, eval=TRUE, out.width="100%"}
ide_use_per_role <- kaggle_survey %>% 
  slice(-1) %>% 
  select(Q5, Q9_Part_1:Q9_Part_10) %>% 
  drop_na(Q5) %>% 
  group_by(Q5) %>% 
  summarise(across(Q9_Part_1:Q9_Part_10, ~ (length(na.omit(.x)) / length(.x))) * 100) %>% 
  set_names(c('role', 'Jupyter Notebook', 'RStudio', 'Visual Studio', 'VSCode', 'PyCharm', 'Spyder', 'Notepad++', 'Sublime Text', 'Vim / Emacs', 'Matlab')) %>%
  gather("lang", "pct", -role) %>% 
  group_by(role) %>% 
  filter(lang != 'None')

hc4 <- ide_use_per_role %>% 
  mutate(pct = round(pct, 2)) %>% 
  hchart("column", hcaes(x = role, y = pct, group = lang)) %>%
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = ""), labels = list(format = "{value}%")) %>%
  hc_xAxis(title = list(text = "")) %>%
  hc_credits(enabled = TRUE, text = "2020 Kaggle Machine Learning & Data Science Survey") %>%
  hc_tooltip(sort = TRUE, table = TRUE)
  
hc4
```
